name: Cuffed
source:
Getting arrested has never been so sexy! Who knew that getting wrongfully arrested would throw you into a passionate, lustful summer fling with a dashing police chief? But when the summer ends, who will be the one to cut ties first? Or will this summer thing become something a little bit more... permanent?

[From in-app]
translation:
被捕从未如此性感！谁知道被错误逮捕会让你与一位风度翩翩的警察局长展开一场充满激情、淫荡的夏季风流韵事？但当夏天结束时，谁会是第一个断绝关系的人呢？或者这个夏天的事情会变得更……永久吗？

[来自应用程序内]
